comments.author: marcosmarxm
comments.body: Hello! Thank you for reporting this issue. It seems the Airbyte connector is currently using Facebook Business version 17, which might be causing the problem. We've added it to our connector backlog for further investigation.

comments.author: meyerovb
comments.body:
except you can't default a new app to a previous api version, so i'll need to do something like mod the source code to add the api version to the url, which isnt configurable in the ui for the source.  i have no idea how to go about that
![image](https://github.com/airbytehq/airbyte/assets/362582/50e03a6a-6977-49bb-b396-3147fcddc8ab)

comments.author: marcosmarxm
comments.body: It looks only changing the version in the code won't fix the issue as the API return an error about fields not being allowed anymore. @meyerovb shared this to the team, hope to get an update soon.

comments.author: meyerovb
comments.body: See “Making Versioned Requests” on [this page](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/versions/). If you don’t put the version into the api url, it defaults to whatever you have set up in your settings. And for a new app u can’t set the settings back to an old version. So I’m stuck, but just modding the api url will be enough to unstick me (until v17 is fully removed that is, then everyone’s screwed).

comments.author: marcosmarxm
comments.body: @meyerovb team is investigating and will return during the week.

comments.author: meyerovb
comments.body: There’s a quick patch fix for this. You don’t need to update the connector to v19, you just have to put v17 into the api url you are using. That way it’ll stop erroring out for anyone who’s created an app recently on v19 until you get around to updating the connector.

comments.body: I apologize @artem1205 seems that creating a new app automatically upgrades all calls using that app's token to the "Upgrade API Version" setting of the app, and you can't set that to a deprecated version, so yeah everyone is stuck until the upgrade is released. I will now go the guaranteed fruitless route of asking facebook to downgrade that setting in my app lol, and let the client know their integration will have to wait.
